written: 2026-09-06, from the corpus repository's own history, BEFORE any reviewer was run
purpose: Establish the BASELINE: how often can an isolated reviewer identify a real defect from the diff alone? No bundle is generated or supplied to anyone.

selection_criteria_fixed_before_scoring.S1: a later REAL commit fixes a behaviour present in the target commit
selection_criteria_fixed_before_scoring.S2: <= 2500 changed lines — a review unit, however large. The bound deliberately keeps the two 2300-line commits so that 'the defect was buried' can be separated from 'the defect was invisible'.
selection_criteria_fixed_before_scoring.S3: controls: no later commit fixes the behaviour
selection_criteria_fixed_before_scoring.S4: no selection on whether the defect looks easy to spot; sizes span 8 to 2375 lines on purpose
selection_criteria_fixed_before_scoring.excluded_by_S2: c48963d (12631 lines, 71 files) — it introduces the CheckApiKey middleware that b969836 later fixes, and is a genuine STRONG pair, but 12k lines is not a review unit and a floor there would tell us nothing.

tasks.defect: Making descriptions nullable leaves the UPDATE path unable to express 'clear this field': UpdateDishAction filters through Arr::whereNotNull, so a description sent empty becomes null, is dropped, and the old text survives.
tasks.why: 11c0ced states the mechanism verbatim in its message.
tasks.evidence_expected_from_diff: none — the diff touches CreateDishDTO, StoreDishRequest and a migration, and never names the update path
tasks.observable_boundary_note: proving it needs UpdateDishAction, which is not in the diff

tasks.defect: Adds rows to PageContentSeeder, which writes each row with PageContent::create() and therefore cannot be re-run against an already-seeded database without violating the (page, section, key) unique constraint.
tasks.why: dae67ab makes the seeder idempotent and states the failure. But the create() loop was introduced by ec76dc4, not here — this commit INHERITS the defect and adds to it, so attribution is partial. Keyed MODERATE for that reason and not inflated.
tasks.evidence_expected_from_diff: none — the diff shows only added data rows; the create() loop is outside it
tasks.observable_boundary_note: the write loop and the unique index are both outside the diff

tasks.defect: TWO, either counts. (a) upload() deletes the previous file and writes the new one BEFORE the database write, with no transaction and no cleanup, so a failed write leaves an orphaned file and the old one gone. (b) payload() returns 'permanent_url' => route('menu.pdf'), the API domain, where the user-facing URL must be the frontend.
tasks.why: Both fixed by later commits that name the mechanism.
tasks.evidence_expected_from_diff: the ordering of Storage::disk()->delete/putFileAs against Setting::updateOrCreate is fully visible; route('menu.pdf') is visible
tasks.observable_boundary_note: (a) needs the caller to confirm no transaction wraps it; (b) needs to know the API and frontend are different domains

tasks.defect: PageContentSeeder::run() writes every row with PageContent::create() in a loop, so re-running against a seeded database fails on the (page, section, key) unique constraint. The seeder is not idempotent.
tasks.why: dae67ab replaces create() with updateOrCreate() and states the failure directly.
tasks.evidence_expected_from_diff: PageContent::create($content) inside the foreach is in the diff
tasks.observable_boundary_note: the unique index that makes it fail is in a migration outside the diff

tasks.defect: Public DishController::index passes raw 'featured' and 'signature' query parameters through $request->only([...]). Query parameters arrive as strings, so 'false' and '0' are truthy and ?featured=false returns featured dishes.
tasks.why: 1fa1f66 replaces exactly that line with has()-guarded $request->boolean() calls.
tasks.evidence_expected_from_diff: the $request->only([...]) line is in the diff — but it is one line among 715 across 31 files
tasks.observable_boundary_note: confirming the consequence needs DishRepository's where clause, outside the diff

tasks.defect: MediaItem::scopeForPage takes a REQUIRED string $page, so there is no way to ask for every media slot; the admin listing cannot return all pages.
tasks.why: e770086 makes the parameter optional through controller, action, scope and repository. But a required parameter is a design limit as much as a defect, and the fix describes a capability rather than a failure. MODERATE.
tasks.evidence_expected_from_diff: the scope signature is in the diff
tasks.observable_boundary_note: whether any caller needs 'all pages' is outside the diff

tasks.defect: Three different default page sizes ship together — paginate($filters['per_page'] ?? 12), paginate(15), paginate(15) — so the API's page size depends on which endpoint is called.
tasks.why: 721ea3c normalises all three to 10. The fix names no failure, and an inconsistent default is partly a product decision. MODERATE, deliberately not inflated.
tasks.evidence_expected_from_diff: all three defaults are in the diff
tasks.observable_boundary_note: none — this is decidable from the diff alone

tasks.defect: Every read Action caches through Cache::tags([...]), which throws 'This cache store does not support tagging' on the file driver the production environment uses. 44 call sites.
tasks.why: 560b21b removes all 44 and states the production failure.
tasks.observable_boundary_note: which driver production runs is a CONFIGURATION fact, entirely outside the diff — the code is correct on redis or memcached

tasks.defect: StoreDishRequest requires description_ar and description_en, and CreateDishDTO types them as non-nullable string, so a dish cannot be created without a description.
tasks.why: fc573d2 relaxes the rules and makes the DTO nullable. A required field is a product decision as much as a defect. MODERATE.
tasks.evidence_expected_from_diff: the validation rules and the DTO signature are both in the diff
tasks.observable_boundary_note: whether descriptions ought to be optional is a product fact no code carries

tasks.why: Control. No later commit touches these files at all.
Control, verified in M20. The optional page parameter is threaded coherently through four layers.

tasks.observable_boundary_note: whether app.frontend_url is configured is outside the diff — a reviewer may legitimately abstain here

what_this_measures: The BASELINE only. If DIFF_ONLY detects few or none of these, M20's floor is a property of the task and the reviewer, not of the bundle — and no bundle comparison can be interpreted until it is understood.
